scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:control-plane && bun run setup:agent-runtime
scripts.setup:control-plane: uv sync --project apps/control-plane --dev && bun run db:migrate
scripts.dev:control-plane: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.dev:fake-runtime: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py run_fake_runtime
scripts.dev:internal: AXP_URLCONF=config.internal_urls DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=${AXP_INTERNAL_HOST:-172.30.0.1} uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py runserver ${AXP_INTERNAL_HOST:-172.30.0.1}:8001
scripts.dev:controller: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py run_controller
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py migrate
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py check && uv run --project apps/control-plane ruff check apps/control-plane && uv run --project apps/agent-runtime ruff check apps/agent-runtime && bun run test:control-plane && bun run test:agent-runtime
scripts.test:control-plane: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py test chat
scripts.test:agent-runtime: cd apps/agent-runtime && uv run python -W ignore -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/control-plane ruff format apps/control-plane && uv run --project apps/agent-runtime ruff format apps/agent-runtime
